home.welcomeDesc: Self-hosted all-in-one dev platform — Git hosting, agile project management, CI/CD pipelines, with code-to-task auto-linking
home.codeHostingDesc: Git version control, branch management, code review
home.issueTrackingDesc: Issue tracking, task management, milestone planning
home.mergeRequestDesc: Code review, collaborative development, quality control
home.scrumFeatureDesc: Sprint iterations, user stories, epics, kanban, backlog — full-flow Scrum management
home.sprintFeatureDesc: Plan iteration cycles, set goals, track burndown charts, deliver efficiently
home.kanbanFeatureDesc: Visualize task flow, drag-and-drop status management, more efficient team collaboration
home.vcsFeatureDesc: Repository hosting, branch management, fork collaboration, merge requests and code review
home.issueFeatureDesc: Issue tracking, task management, milestone planning, full lifecycle management
home.mergeRequestFeatureDesc: Code review, collaborative development, quality control, safe merging
home.devLoopFeatureDesc: Push branch auto-starts task, MR opens enters review, merge completes. Code actions and task status seamlessly linked
home.workflowFeatureDesc: Custom task statuses and transition rules, FS/SS/FF/SF dependency hard-blocking, adapt to your team's real process
home.cicdFeatureDesc: Built-in pipeline executor, .iforge-ci.yml declarative config, auto build, test, deploy
home.aiFeatureDesc: AI-powered task description optimization and requirement analysis, conversational interaction with thinking process
home.noActivityDesc: Creating repos, committing code, opening Issues will appear here
